narrative: Arguably the biggest six-pointer of the season — two sides staring at the drop meet in a game that could define both their fates. Igor Tudor's Spurs are winless in 5 since his appointment (16th, 29pts), while Vitor Pereira's Forest are 18th (28pts) and already in the relegation zone. Both managers are under extreme pressure. One of them will leave this game with something to hold onto — the other could be looking at a manager change within days.
